idea-plugin.name: Agent YOLO
idea-plugin.description:
Agent YOLO is a standalone AI Agents panel for IntelliJ IDEA. It lists your AI CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, CodeBuddy, Qoder, or your own) and launches any of them in a real, interactive terminal inside the IDE with a single click — no Terminal plugin required. Everything the agent prints becomes clickable: jump from its output straight to the code.

  • YOLO panel — A dedicated tool window (right side, y icon) that replicates the Terminal's AI Agents experience, built entirely on public IntelliJ APIs so it passes Marketplace verification. The agent list loads instantly from a cached install scan and refreshes in the background.
  • YOLO mode — A "Skip permissions" toggle in the panel. When on, the next agent launches with its skip-permissions flag (e.g. --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo, -y). Per-agent, fully configurable, and off by default.
  • Real in-panel terminal — Launching an agent opens it in a genuine PTY-backed terminal (JediTerm + PTY4J, the same emulator IDEA bundles). Focus lands in the terminal automatically and Ctrl+C interrupts the agent (SIGINT) instead of triggering IDEA's Copy.
  • Clickable terminal output — File paths (src/Foo.kt:42, ~/x/y.kt:3, C:\foo\Bar.kt:7, line ranges, quoted paths), stack-trace frames (Bar.java:123, Python File "x", line N), bare file names (plugin.xml), Java/Kotlin type names and Class.member references, and http(s):// URLs all become links. Clicking a file/type/member opens it in the editor and auto-hides the panel; URLs open in your browser.

⚠️ Warning — about "YOLO mode" / the skip-permissions flag: letting an AI agent run commands and edit files without confirmation can make irreversible changes, execute untrusted code, or expose your system. These risks come entirely from the agent and the bypass flag itself. This plugin only flips that flag for you — it adds no such behavior of its own, performs no actions on your behalf, and is not responsible for what the agent does. Enable YOLO mode only in trusted environments.
